projectState.summary: Track D1 is implemented on codex/byte-d1-candidate-cycle. The branch adds runCandidateCycle() as a composition layer over B4 produceProsodyCandidates(), A1 persistence writes, A2 aggregateCandidateFitness(), A3 selectCandidates(), and A4 developCandidate(). It stores/scored phrase candidates, selects elites, purges overflow, develops each elite through the audited phrase.nudge path, and exposes window.persistence.runCandidateCycle() for inspection. Repeated identical cycles skip reselection when the produced set is already settled so developed children are not purged and no duplicate candidate audit events are appended. No audio/model/playback/transport behavior consumes the cycle. Validation: build green, db:smoke green, smoke 58/58, diff-check green; npm audit still reports the known Vite/esbuild advisories.
